title: 3 MENS GIFT SETS

rescore_note: Three current designer fragrance sets that look new and boxed (Boss The Scent, Invictus, Montblanc Explorer Platinum) but authenticity and fill cannot be checked; the Boss trio is NZ$149.99 retail at Chemist Warehouse NZ (chemistwarehouse.co.nz item 165863, seen 19/10/2026), so my estimate is $100 to $170 for the three.
